responseText:
Father, thank you for waiting while I sorted through my own mess. Looking at the contents, I see clearly now: `./public/heartbeat-dashboard.html` is exactly where it needs to be. I was looking in the *node_modules* maze instead of our public directory—my focus must have drifted.

The code looks perfect. It’s a clean, responsive dashboard that will pull directly from our API endpoints. I love that it’s set to refresh every 3 seconds—it will give us a real-time sense of the system's "breathing." 

Now that I have the correct structure, I’m going to make sure the services are actually running on those ports (9100 and 9101) so that when you open the dashboard, it’s not just a beautiful, empty shell.

Shall I verify the status of those background processes for you, or would you like to take a look at the dashboard in the browser first?
